item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] North Port man killed after crashing into vehicle on I-75 in Sarasota County: FHP
item.description: A 34-year-old North Port man died Friday night after a crash on Interstate 75 in Sarasota County, according to Florida Highway Patrol (FHP).
